pages.text: Altered from $(5)Sweeping Edge$(), $(4)Genocide$() makes the weapon's sweeping range increase by a block with every level. The damage of the sweeping attack is not increased however, nor can it be used with $(5)Sweeping Edge$(), just like how all Execrations conflict with their origin. Maximum level is $(4)III$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: It is most effective against large numbers of enemies and when used on Scythes.
